text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It was the ultimate race, truly fitting 
for a climax!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However! The road to becoming the 
"strongest" is still long!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, words of encouragement!! I pray 
from the bottom of my heart for <chrname>'s valiant 
fight!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right, for better or worse, there are 
still 2 races left... I can't afford to 
let my guard down!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It was the ultimate race, truly fitting 
for a climax!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And—I am in awe! <chrname>, too, with an 
indomitable spirit, is setting their 
sights on the next race!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming the "strongest" is 
still long! However! It is by no means 
closed off to us!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, words of encouragement!! I pray 
from the bottom of my heart for <chrname>'s valiant 
fight!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right, for better or worse, there are 
still 2 races left... There are still 
plenty of chances!"
